Class Gui

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
mesos.am30.client.Gui
All Implemented Interfaces:
IF_GameUI
public class Gui extends javafx.application.Application implements IF_GameUI
JavaFX entry point for the graphical client.
Implements IF_GameUI and delegates all game events to the appropriate scene controller.
